risk_summary: The disclosure is materially quantified and candid about recession-driven revenue declines, project delays, cancellations, backlog reduction, and contract-cost uncertainty. Liquidity, low leverage, diversification, and substantial backlog provide mitigating factors, but backlog quality is weakened because contracts may be cancelled and government awards may be unfunded.
